label: late original-phase token just after a u
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, at positions 4-8 (peak at 5-6); almost never at the delimiter and never in the copy phase. The strongest activations come on the token immediately after an input u (prev_tok==u, t>=4: 96% precision, about 51% of activation mass). The step two after a u is weaker (e.g. z r y n u [u] [m] [2]: the peak is on the token after the second u). Weaker boosts come when the previous token is v, a digit 2/3, d, w or q. The rest is diffuse, low-magnitude firing at positions 5-7 of longer sequences (L>=7), with no clear token trigger. Does not fire at t<4, in the copy phase, or on the final token after u when t=8 and L=9 (the last original step is often silent). Predicate (u one or two steps back, t>=4) captures about 66% of mass at about 74% precision but misses the diffuse low-level part.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: u, v, 2, d, w, 3; least: r, l, y, z) and the input two steps back (most: u, 2, v, q, d, w; least: l, r, z, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=5, t=7.
